question: Recover source-declared GROOMING relationships from the actual work-backlog-item entry, without executing them.
claim_scope: Pinned normative source relationships, not runtime observations, desired design, expected/gold answers, or an adjudicated workflow.
relationship_fields: Local extraction representation only. Each relationship separately names actor, action, condition, effect, artifact, continuation or terminal, and source evidence IDs. A null terminal means that relationship does not itself terminate the workflow. Shared source spans are intentionally reused for distinct meanings. Source ambiguities/contradictions are independently recorded in check-output.json, not silently reconciled.
